body:
NOT CLEAN: deciding review of head 5550edf6 (Opus 5.5). Four web defects and one small race, posted inline. The server and core parts are sound.

There were no earlier review comments on this PR, so this pass had nothing to re-check and reviewed the whole diff. The verdict covers the code only. It does not speak for CI, which was not read.

**Still broken (inline):**
1. `ForumTopicView.tsx:101`: the "Anyone on the web can read this forum" sheet comes back after the member has agreed. ForumPage's `front` stays `told: false`, and `markForumTold` updates only the kept copy. It reappears on the second reply in a topic, and on the first reply after starting a topic that went up at once. **Measured** with a throwaway test on this head: `sheet shown again = true` after the node had recorded `/told`.
2. `ForumTopicView.tsx:109`: after Send, or any ⋯ action, a topic longer than 30 posts reloads only its first 30. The member's own reply is not drawn and their place is lost. **Measured**: 40 posts read to the end, then Send, left 29 replies drawn, #40 gone and own reply #41 not drawn.
3. `ForumTopicView.tsx:173`: when the member's own action makes the topic 404, the old copy stays on screen with no message. This happens when they remove their opening post in a topic nobody answered, or block the topic's own writer. Found by reading against engine/forum.ts `visibleTopic` and `blankTopic`.
4. `ForumPage.tsx:164`: a topic whose opening post was removed but which has others' replies is listed with a blank title. The server sends `title: ''` and `removed: true`, and TopicRow has no fallback (the topic view has one).
5. `ForumPage.tsx:71` (minor): switching sections quickly can leave the earlier section's answer on screen under the newer pick.

**Checked and sound:**
- **Server, F5 carry-over.** `markPushNoticesSeenWhere(…, kinds)` filters by kind only when `kinds` is given, so a chat's open and a kept alert's acknowledge are unchanged. `bellSeenWhere` now marks only `forum.reply`, `forum.mention` and `forum.first-look-answer`, through `afterBellMark`, so the kept copy is marked too and a moderation notice naming the same topic stays. Narrowing `markBellNoticesSeenWhere`'s field type leaves no caller passing `topicId`. The new §8 assertions in `test-forum-notices.ts` go through the real `tell()` and `/read`.
- **Core tour.** The word `chatForum` is used only where `forumOn(features)`, which is the same test `chatSides` uses for the switch, so the words match what is drawn. Step ids, count and resume are unchanged. The phone passes the same fact from `strip.profile.features`, and `chats.tsx` is untouched.
- **Web wiring.** The tour's nonce bump lands on Chats. ChatTabPage passes `me` and `onOpenProfile`. Request paths and shapes match `routes/forum.ts` and engine/forum.ts. Links are plain for new writers, and known writers' links open with `nofollow ugc` and an `https://` prefix. Report sends `targetForumPostId`. First looks: Say no stays off until a reason is picked. The two changed tests weaken no assertion.

**How this pass ran:** read-only. `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then built core and engine, waiting on the heavy-test lock each time. The two measurements ran from a vitest file in the reviewer's scratch space, outside the repo. Nothing in the branch was edited, committed or pushed.

CLEAN: deciding review of head 33a37470 (Opus 5.5). All five findings from the 5550edf6 pass are fixed, and nothing new is broken. No inline comments this round.

The verdict covers the code only. It does not speak for CI ("Run BeanPool Test-All Pipeline"), which this pass did not read.

**Earlier findings, checked again:**
1. **The sheet shows once: fixed.** ForumPage owns the stamp: `told()` sets `front.told` (`ForumPage.tsx:96`). ForumTopicView (`:302`) and ForumNewTopic (`:99`) both call `onTold` after `/told` and before they send. A topic opened from a new topic gets the stamped front. It is covered by two tests ("a second reply in the same topic", "a topic that goes up at once") and by the new second-reply check in the e2e walk.
2. **A long topic keeps the reader's range: fixed.** `readThrough(from, upTo)` (`ForumTopicView.tsx:102`) pages the same way engine/forum.ts `forumTopic` does: 30 posts after `after`, blocked writers left out, and `next` is the last number while more follow.
   - Send reads from the last post drawn through `mine.number`.
   - Each ⋯ action reads from 0 through the last post drawn.
   - Opening a topic reads through the last post kept.
   - The loop stops when `next` doesn't move forward, and a blocked writer's posts dropping out doesn't break it.
3. **A topic gone by the member's own action: fixed.** On a 404 with `not_found` (what `visibleTopic` throws; lib/api.ts `refusalError` carries the status and code), `forgetForumTopic` drops the kept topic and its rows in every kept list. The member goes back to the list, which shows one line:
   - the node's words, after removing an opening post nobody answered;
   - `goneBlocked`, after blocking the topic's writer.
   `feature_off` still shows the failure text. The `shown` guard (33a37470) stops a late answer for a topic the member already left from moving them or marking that topic read.
4. **A removed topic's title in the list: fixed.** `ForumPage.tsx:181` uses the topic view's "A removed topic".
5. **The section race: fixed.** `loadList` remembers the section it asked for. `picked` is updated in an effect declared before the loader's effect, so an older section's answer, or its error, is dropped. The kept copy is still filed under its own key.

**Profile doors (the CI red):** the three new doors hand App's `onOpenProfile` on unchanged, and ForumTopicView's one call is the writer's name with `post.writer.publicKey`. EnterpriseNotAProfile now checks this as well as listing the doors.

**Server and core:** unchanged since the last pass (`66134d6e..HEAD` touches only apps/pwa). No caller merged in from main passes `topicId` to the narrowed `markBellNoticesSeenWhere`.

**Run on this head** (waiting on the heavy-test lock each time):
- pwa vitest: ForumPage 24/24, EnterpriseNotAProfile 13/13, ChatTabPage and App.chatSideWaysIn: 55/55 across 4 files.
- pwa and server `tsc --noEmit`: clean.
- eslint on the forum files: 0 errors (18 `any` warnings, in tests).
- `words.mjs lint` and `check`: ok, nothing new.
- The Playwright walk was not run (no node contacted).

**Not posted, because each needs a race:**
- A Send or ⋯ action taken while the topic's opening read is still in flight shares the kept copy with that read. It can leave a gap, or drop the new reply from view, until the next open.
- `goneBlocked` is passed for any block. If someone else removes the topic at the same moment the member blocks a reply's writer, the list gives the wrong reason.

Read-only pass: nothing was edited, committed or pushed.
